# Preliminary incident assessment
Generated: 2026-10-16T19:27:56.373Z
Incident type: forest_fire | Location: the village | Severity (system assessment): high

## Summary
A forest fire is reported near the village, with smoke rising from hills and flames visible near the first houses. A strong wind is blowing toward the village, increasing the threat. The image shows flames on a hillside adjacent to water, with thick smoke illuminating the sky orange.

## 1. What was reported
- Smoke is rising from the hills behind the village (reported)
- flames are visible near the first houses (reported)
- A strong wind is blowing toward the village (reported)

## 2. What was observed in the image
- Bright orange flames burning along the slope and ridge of a hill in the background. (high) (image)
- Thick smoke rising from the fire, filling the sky with a bright orange glow. (high) (image)
- A dark body of water in the foreground reflecting the light from the fire. (high) (image)
- A metal gantry or sign structure visible in the middle-right foreground. (medium) (image)
- Red light trails at the bottom edge suggesting moving vehicles on a road. (medium) (image)
- Inconsistency: The report mentions flames near houses, but no houses are clearly visible in the image.
- Inconsistency: The report mentions wind direction, which cannot be determined from the image.

## 3. Relevant information from the knowledge base
- Se mettre en sécurité immédiatement, porter des masques respiratoires N95 adaptés aux besoins de chacun, y compris les médicaments et les animaux. (entry_id: FI-21, chunk_id: fr/fire_kb.md::section::8) (knowledge_base)
- Conservez les documents importants dans un coffre ignifugé, avec des copies numériques protégées par mot de passe, et vérifiez que votre assurance suffit à remplacer vos biens. (entry_id: FI-21, chunk_id: fr/fire_kb.md::section::8) (knowledge_base)
- Utilisez des matériaux résistants au feu pour construire, rénover ou réparer, prévoyez un point d'eau extérieur avec un tuyau qui atteint toutes les zones de votre terrain, et créez une zone résistante au feu d’au moins 30 feet autour de votre maison, dépourvue de feuilles, de débris et de matériaux inflammables. (entry_id: FI-23, chunk_id: fr/fire_kb.md::section::8) (knowledge_base)
- Évacuez et partez immédiatement si les autorités vous le demandent; sinon, abritez‑vous dans une habitation débroussaillée jusqu’à l’arrivée des secours, la voiture n’est pas un abri sûr. (entry_id: FI-24, chunk_id: fr/fire_kb.md::section::8) (knowledge_base)
- Donnez l’alerte aux services de secours, mettez‑vous à l’abri dans une habitation débroussaillée, restez informé de la situation et suivez les consignes des secours ou de la mairie. (entry_id: FI-14, chunk_id: fr/fire_kb.md::section::2) (knowledge_base)
- Use fire‑resistant materials to build, renovate or repair, find an outdoor water source with a hose that can reach any area of your property, and create a fire‑resistant zone free of leaves, debris or flammable materials for at least 30 feet from your home. (entry_id: FI-11, chunk_id: en/fire_kb.md::section::10) (knowledge_base)
- Evacuate and leave immediately if authorities tell you to do so; otherwise, take shelter in a cleared house until rescuers arrive, and a car is not a safe shelter because it could burn. (entry_id: FI-13, chunk_id: en/fire_kb.md::section::10) (knowledge_base)
- Sign up for your community’s warning system, know your community’s evacuation routes and have several ways to leave, gather emergency supplies including N95 respirator masks, keep important documents in a fire‑proof safe and review insurance coverage to ensure it is sufficient. (entry_id: FI-10, chunk_id: en/fire_kb.md::section::9) (knowledge_base)

No guidance available in the knowledge base for this point. Follow the instructions of the authorities and emergency services.
